items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: We played, me and Orin, and we played Miss Lones.

ctx.x: They used big bands for that? I mean. Oh, yeah.
Sure. We used to play them. Oh, we played them. We played, me and Orin, and we played Miss Lones. A lady called Miss, what's her name? Hey, Bill.
Is it Betsy Cole, maybe? Miss Cole.
